g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
The difference between blocking a Gmail sender and
reporting spam: What to check if messages still go to
Spam after blocking
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-06
Distinguish blocking from reporting
spam first
According to Google Help, blocking a sender
moves emails from that sender to Spam.
Block a sender in Gmail on the web
On a computer, open Gmail and open a message
sent by the sender.
How to unblock a sender from the
blocked list
If you can no longer find the sender’s messages,
open the Filters and Blocked Addresses list in
Settings.
Example: Messages from a business
contact still go to Spam after…
This is a hypothetical example.
